title: Target Closing Date for a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Extension
content:
The days a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit extension must cover are counted in calendar days from the credit's current expiration date to the target closing date.

**Choice of the target closing date.**

- Where a closing is scheduled with the settlement agent for the loan file — a scheduled closing under the borrower's Closing and Funding engagement — the target closing date is that scheduled closing date.
- Where no closing is scheduled and the purchase contract closing date is later than the estimated closing date on the loan file, it is the purchase contract closing date.
- Otherwise it is the estimated closing date on the loan file.

The purchase contract closing date and the estimated closing date are the ones recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File.

| Closing scheduled with the settlement agent | Purchase contract closing date later than the estimated closing date | Target closing date |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the scheduled closing date |
| no | yes | the purchase contract closing date |
| no | no (earlier, the same day, or none) | the estimated closing date |

### Cases (hypothetical dates; current expiration date 30 May 2026)

| Scheduled closing | Contract closing date | Estimated closing date | Target | Calendar days from the expiration date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 19 June 2026 | 25 June 2026 | 12 June 2026 | 19 June 2026 | 20 |
| none | 25 June 2026 | 12 June 2026 | 25 June 2026 | 26 |
| none | 12 June 2026 | 12 June 2026 | 12 June 2026 | 13 |
